about_p1: Glen from Jim’s Auto did a great job towing my truck to “my” mechanic, which was all locked up by the time we got there. I called the mechanic telling him that I’m having my truck towed there, at 5pm they were long gone. Glen said that he could take it to Jim’s Auto, which he did. My Truck was fixed fast, and it was reasonably priced. A few weeks earlier Jim, (the owner) came to my house to tow my 1969 Chevy Nova.
about_p2: Great people all around. Glenn came out and helped on an emergency call late at night, and couldn't have been more helpful and informative. Got everything fixed quickly and professionally. The next day at the garage was more of the same, the staff all did exactly what was needed while being polite and explaining what needed to be fixed. Thankful for all the help that Jim's provided.

services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Bob Freeman
reviews.text: Glen from Jim’s Auto did a great job towing my truck to “my” mechanic, which was all locked up by the time we got there. I called the mechanic telling him that I’m having my truck towed there, at 5pm they were long gone. Glen said that he could take it to Jim’s Auto, which he did. My Truck was fixed fast, and it was reasonably priced. A few weeks earlier Jim, (the owner) came to my house to tow my 1969 Chevy Nova. Jim handled my car with the upmost care, he has old cars, and knows how to secure them properly. Jim’s auto is a family owned business, and that’s why he does a great job. Thanks Jim & Glen!

reviews.author: Graham Frazier
reviews.text: Great people all around. Glenn came out and helped on an emergency call late at night, and couldn't have been more helpful and informative. Got everything fixed quickly and professionally. The next day at the garage was more of the same, the staff all did exactly what was needed while being polite and explaining what needed to be fixed. Thankful for all the help that Jim's provided.

reviews.author: Mollie
reviews.text: I had requested a Tow Truck service through AAA to help me get from a Love‘s gas station in Fair Play, South Carolina To Northwest Metro Atlanta in Georgia. The tow truck driver, Glenn, was very responsive and communicated ETA and allowed us to follow him to Georgia with stops for gas and snacks and allow the pups a break to go pee. Given that we were going into some of the rougher and heavier, traffic and interstates, I greatly appreciated his additional efforts and commitments to installing multi straps on my 1982 Volkswagen Vanagon Westfalia. He was a true delight, upbeat, and energetic! Highly recommend Jim’s Auto in the southern areas of South Carolina off of I 85!

reviews.author: Danielle Barber
reviews.text: Glenn was awesome! I work around construction and got a nail in my tire on my way to meet people. He had everything wrapped up so quickly that I was able to keep my appointment and finish my job. I expected to drive around on a spare and he was able to plug my tire. I’m so grateful!

reviews.author: Lauren Herman
reviews.text: Shiveraly IS NOT DEAD! My brand new Toyota Highlander blew a tire on 85 and I had to pull over on a small shoulder. Want to talk about nerve-wracking?? BUT triple A sent the best tow service. He got there so quickly, and had us loaded up and to the dealership just in time for them to be able to fix my tire before they closed! The driver Glenn, was kind, courteous, and friendly! I am so appreciative to him!

reviews.author: Emily Brunson
reviews.text: Breaking down on 85 is a really scary experience, but thank the good Lord for a quick and speedy rescue by this tow company! Our driver Glenn, was so friendly, and got us towed to a dealership quickly! We enjoyed his friendly personality and great customer service! If you need a tow in the area we HIGHLY recommended this company and Glenn!! Thank yall so much!

reviews.author: George Romagosa
reviews.text: Truly amazing!;The service that Kylie and Bradley gave me was top notch. I live in South Florida and made the decision to wait until I came back to South Carolina to the work done. Well worth the trip. Done promptly and professionally. Can't be beat.

reviews.author: Brittany Johnson
reviews.text: My dually truck got stuck in a very awkward position. They responded fast, the tow truck driver was extremely knowledgeable, very friendly, and he was extra careful to ensure my vehicle wouldn't be damaged when pulling it out. He made the whole experience completely stress free and for someone with anxiety that was a huge thing for me. The driver was joking with us and had us laughing and was just a really nice guy. Overall a really wonderful experience and I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jo El Ducheene
reviews.text: We had a breakdown and worked through our insurance who connected us to Jim's. 1. They were super responsive, fast and excellent customer service 2. They were accommodating to timing and worked together to make the situation less stressfull. 3. The driver ( Sean ) was helpful, prepared, knowledgeable, friendly and offered guidance and suggestions for future, similar incidents. Overall - excellent experience from beginning to end.

reviews.author: Jon Bratton
reviews.text: After just purchasing a used 2012 Toyota Sienna, I was taking it to my Mom in NC when it broke down on I-85N in SC. I called Jim’s tow service and he and his employee took me and my van to his shop (Jim’s Auto). Turns out it was my alternator. Jim had his guys jump right on it and installed a new alternator and even stayed after hours to finish the job so I wouldn’t be stranded! I can’t speak highly enough about Jim and his operation there. They got me buttoned up and I was on my way in short order with my van running great! Everyone there was very friendly. First class operation! Highly recommend! John

reviews.author: hannah k
reviews.text: Major shout out to Kevin Phillips! On 5/22 Kevin towed our car to our house in FairPlay from Clemson. He was great!! Even with all the rain going on, he still got our car to our house with no issues. Great guy and made sure to take care of our car!!!!!

reviews.author: Clayton White
reviews.text: Our serpentine belt and tensioner became an issue. We were on vacation out in Devils Fork. Jim’s Auto was recommended By the mechanic working on our truck. We found them to be professional friendly, and provided an outstanding service. He was helpful and was kind and respectful of my wife and the dogs. He stepped through everything he was doing and what the process was. I hope to never have another need for a tow truck, if I do and I’m in this area, I would definitely reach out to Jim’s

reviews.author: Samantha Cragg
reviews.text: My husband was broken down near their shop and we were attempting to fix his truck when one of their drivers happened to show up to the convenient store. We didn’t ask him for help but he came over and introduced himself as Shawn and asked if we needed help, and he tried to help us start the truck in a couple of different ways. He ended up helping us push the truck out of the way. He didn’t have to stop and help but we were so grateful for his assistance and knowledge. Shout out to Shawn and Harvey for making the situation manageable and being kind to strangers. We definitely will be using their services from now on!

reviews.author: Daniel Mattson
reviews.text: My father was driving my 2010 Mini Cooper from GA to MD when a belt came off. They treated him great and did everything they could to get him back on the road! They did a great job! I truly appreciate everything they did to get him back on the road.

reviews.author: James Lynn
reviews.text: We broke down on I-85 in the middle of a 10 hour drive. James first came out to help diagnose the problem. Then Glenn came by to tow us to the repair garage. Both guys were friendly and excellent in their skill to get us where we needed to go.

reviews.author: Jonas Sparks
reviews.text: Very unprofessional towing service, i scheduled a pickup for 8am a day in advance and they were over an hour late. I eventually gave up and cancelled on them, they also charge 125 dollars, which is high for the poor service they have. 0/10 would not recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Winter
reviews.text: Highly recommend.. AC went out hours before I was suppose to get on the road for travel.. they got me in parts order and complete all same day.. I’m very thankful for their fast efficient service!!

reviews.author: April Duncan
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Glenn got there 30 minutes faster than OnStar said he would and he changed my tire quickly and I was on my way. Very good customer service!

reviews.author: Larry Cossio
reviews.text: Took my truck over to have some filters changed and check my brakes. They were quick to jump right on it and review the brakes. Seem to be honest and knowledgeable about my RAM. They do alignments brakes oil changes and also have their own tow truck

reviews.author: Joni P
reviews.text: I can't say enough positive about Jim's Auto! I was traveling through the area when I experienced both a fuel and brake line leak on Sunday afternoon. They had my rig fixed and back on the road before noon on Monday! Treated me like family! Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

reviews.author: Austin Barrett
reviews.text: Took my car to Jim’s auto to have a custom body kit installed, custom color paint job, bigger turbos installed, full exhaust system, inlets, chargepipe, intercooler, injectors, stage 4 fueling system, aftermarket coil packs and coil pack harness,transmission service, walnut blast on the intake valves, rims, tires, brakes and full suspension work done and the car is a completely different car. They did an awesome job, couldn’t be more pleased with the turn out. 10/10 would recommend for all your car needs

reviews.author: Tommy Walters
reviews.text: Ive no,ed Jim ever sense he moved here.Hes a honest straight up guy.And so is his son.They do great work

reviews.author: Dawn Hart
reviews.text: I can not express how grateful I was for Glenn from Jims Auto for working with me to get my car towed. He was extremely nice! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Ed Harris
reviews.text: Luke was a consummate professional with excellent communication when our vehicle was towed. He dropped it off at the dealership outside of business hours without any issues. Thank you Luke!

reviews.author: Michael Wilkerson
reviews.text: Glenn rocks, has one of the best personalities and got to me quick when I needed a tow. Great guy great company would def recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Mr. H
reviews.text: Shout out to Kylie at Jim's Auto. She worked with our family to keep body work on a Ford truck within budget. All I can say is that the team's work is phenomenal and surpassed all expectations. Jim's Auto is THE PLACE for great work and from a team you can trust!

reviews.author: Jason Peters
reviews.text: Excellent service. Glenn Norton was professional courteous and timely. I’d highly recommend them. I had the pleasure of dealing with Glenn Norton again. He is awesome

reviews.author: Myles Faust
reviews.text: Great experience. Very slow wait time, locksmith job was quickly done. Glenn was great! Very funny guy, made the process simple. Thanks Glenn!

reviews.author: Feint
reviews.text: The people are rude. They arnt very good at their jobs and very greedy. Highly do not recommend stopping here if you are having car trouble anywhere else would be better.

reviews.author: Mariella Calvani
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND! They were extremely efficient, knowledgeable, and kind. I was in a pinch after calling about 15 places with no luck, and AAA recommended Jim's. I'm so glad they did. It was honestly the most seamless experience I've ever had with a car shop. You can tell it's a family-oriented business that truly cares about its customers.

reviews.author: Bruce Calhoun
reviews.text: We broke down on I85 on our way to Birmingham, AL. AAA sent Jim's Auto tow truck to get us. The mechanics and owners of Jim's Auto went above and beyond to get our truck running and to help us with a loaner car to get to a motel for the night They were a lifesaver for stranded travelers. Their charges to repair our truck were very reasonable.

reviews.author: Michael Killian
reviews.text: Excellent and timely service. Glenn was quite friendly and understanding of my car’s issues. 5/5, definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Kathy Davis
reviews.text: Tyler is a cracker jack mechanic. He does dependable work and is very knowledgeable and polite. He doesn't "blow you off" and is willing to explain all that he does to your car. Jim's Auto is a great place to go for car repair. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Hailie Marie
reviews.text: Jim's Auto is a great place to get your car looked at and worked on. All the guys in the shop have great attitudes and James was a huge help when it came to tires. The ladies in the office are super friendly and were helpful in every way. Mikey the tow truck driver is a great sport and was super helpful and we loved how his truck glowed. The vinyl work was great and done by Jim's Auto as well. So if you need something vinyl done just check out Jim's.

reviews.author: Ken Boozer
reviews.text: Glenn was fast, efficient professional and added humor to the ordeal of having your vehicle towed. Would use him again.

reviews.author: Megan Wentworth
reviews.text: We had a breakdown on the way to a family reunion in Pennsylvania. Jim’s Auto towed the car in and made it a priority to diagnose and fix the car first thing the next day. We were able to be back on the road by the afternoon and make it to our reunion. Six weeks later, all repairs are still great. We would highly recommend the service and work quality.

reviews.author: Sophie O'Connor
reviews.text: My brand new car was hit in the front and it needed to be fixed. My neighbor recommended Jim's Auto and I am SO GLAD HE DID. They fixed my car beautifully and quickly. AND, it was much more affordable than the other quote I got at another collision repair place. I AM HAPPY and will recommend Jim's without reservation. Thanks guys!!!!!

reviews.author: Alicia Castro
reviews.text: THIS IS THE BEST TOWING, MECHANICAL, BODY, AND ELECTRICAL place ever I have came here 7 years and it’s the best work ever Austin is the best on the body side 5 STARS!!

reviews.author: Karis Martin
reviews.text: Glenn was timely, professional, helpful and kind when I was stuck on the side of the road. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marcia Young
reviews.text: Must give these people high praise. Had a new starter put on my Ram truck 2 months ago and it started making a noise again . I just dropped by and asked them to take a look . They had me leave it and a couple of days later they called said they had a new starter in it and no charge all under their warranty. No hassle, no argument pure great customer service . Tyler and the office ladies are great employees. Thank you !

reviews.author: Adam Sweat
reviews.text: Had two dead batteries they came out and handled both of them! The owner was super helpful and walked me through the issues with both cars. Both vehicles had different issues and he was able to tell me what was going on with both of them. We’re also new to the area and the owner was able to give us a some great tips and information about the area.

reviews.author: Derek Sherman
reviews.text: Took my truck in for a tune up and to fix an engine stutter and the service was outstanding. Excellent Communication on the status of my truck. Very friendly and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rebecca Boswinkle
reviews.text: I locked my keys in the car pretty late on a Saturday and they drove an hour to come help me out greatly appreciated tonight thank you!!

reviews.author: Mark Eiland
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job on my Honda CRV repair after tree fell on it. Great customer service and communication with me and my insurance company.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: Timothy came to tow my truck from my job when it wouldn't start. He came out very quickly and had great communication on the way. We dropped the car off at my home and he even put it right where it needed to go. Thanks for making a bad day of auto troubles easier.

reviews.author: John Scott Davidson
reviews.text: GREAT SHOP! I have been doing business with Jim for years. Always trustworthy and does great work. Tyler is taking over some of the workload now and also has been great!

reviews.author: Shana Makison (Shana Makison)
reviews.text: My daughter was broken down on the side of the road late at night with a flat tire and stripped lug nuts (side not: Goodyear stripped her lug nuts) so we were unable to change the tire ourselves. We requested roadside assistance through our insurance and a company called Jack rabbit was dispatched with an ETA of about 50 minutes. They never showed up or contacted us. We gave them about an extra 40 minutes past the ETA, still didn't show so I tried calling their number, which isn't even local, it was a New Jersey area code to find out where our help was and I had to leave a message after holding for 6 minutes! We contacted insurance again to have another company dispatched as she had been on the side of the road for 2 hours at this point and it's after midnight. They then dispatched Jim's Auto and ETA was 50 minutes. Within minutes of hanging up from insurance, Jim's auto called and said they would be there in about 15/20 minutes and that they didn't have the tool for stripped lug nuts but they could try another method. Sure enough, Marcus showed up much quicker than the original ETA and was able to remove the lug nuts and get the spare tire on very quickly. I am incredibly impressed and so, so thankful for Jim's auto. I highly recommend them for emergency roadside help. I know I'll be requesting them specifically if we're ever in need again. After hours of stress and anger Marcus was truly our hero to the rescue. Thank you so much Jim's Auto and Marcus!

reviews.author: magicbychris83
reviews.text: They lied to us. And said AAA Didn't work with Rowlands in Anderson. And said this car care service was in Anderson on 24. A bunch of lies

reviews.author: Eric Hicks
reviews.text: I wanted to write this review because this is the best AAA service we have ever experienced. We lost the key fob for our Ford Explorer and needed assistance in getting into the vehicle. My wife called AAA, and made it clear that this was not an emergency, however Jim's AAA team showed up less than 30 minutes later and well after 5 pm. The AAA guys were very professional and kind. They were able to unlock our Explorer in no time. But, what made this interaction over the top was the fact that the AAA guys showed us how to unlock our vehicle with a code in the owner's manual. We have had this vehicle for ten years, but the dealer never showed us this! This little bit of knowledge was awesome! Many thanks to the two AAA guys that came out to assist us!

reviews.author: Tara Thrift
reviews.text: I needed a tow today and after calling around Jim’s was the first available that could tow the very large truck I needed moved. To my delight Tim was super quick to come to the rescue very friendly and professional. Watching him work I knew I had a seasoned veteran and was so thankful for the experience and service I received!!! I would highly recommend this company. Ask for Tim and I promise you will receive top quality service!!!! Thanks Jim’s for sending Tim!!! You have a life long customer moving forward!!!

reviews.author: Cassandra Trotter
reviews.text: Very unpleasant experience,not friendly, didn't explain what was going on with my car but I was charged a diagnostic fee. I went in to pick up my car and a Pitbull came out of the room growling at me ,a woman working there put him back in the room and a few minutes later while waiting for my car to be towed I see this same dog walking over to where I'm standing growling at me again. I would not recommend this place to anyone. The tow truck driver was really nice though.

reviews.author: Stephen Matthews
reviews.text: Thomas Michael is a great dude! He toad my car five hours to my home and was very professional. This company was prompt from AAA and I wasn't waiting hours. It was a great experience.

reviews.author: Bruce Bennett
reviews.text: Daughter got her car repaired there,from what I observed they seem to be top notch but a little pricey.

reviews.author: Belinda Moreno
reviews.text: 2 weeks they had my car , they never checked the power steering pump that i came in for but wanted to charge me two thousand dollars but would tell me why?? They are thieves and don't go

reviews.author: SummerRain Jackson
reviews.text: Had my son's car brought in for two new tires, to diagnose what was going on with front right tire, and labor for breaks because I'd already purchased the parts but didn't have the time to put them on myself. Remembered the blower was making a horrific noise and vibrations and called and asked if they could look at it too. Spoke to the mechanic Tyler a few times with updates and giving my permission before any work not previously quoted was added along with an updated charge amount. I picked my son's car up the next day with new tires, an answer to what was wrong with the front right tire (bent wheel) and it fixed, the blower cleaned out causing the ac to be so nice and quiet and it was also aligned. They did great work, saved me time I didn't have to spare and at a reasonable price. I appreciate the calls keeping me updated and requesting permission before doing any extra work. I trusted them with my child's car, and I do not regret it.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: I was visiting a friend in Westminster and my alternator was in question of getting me back to East Tennessee, and then the next day to southern New Jersey. I contacted Jim and he extended special courtesy to me getting my vehicle repaired in half a day. Otherwise I would have been stranded. Jim and his staff made sure I was taken care of. They were knowledgeable, professional, friendly and courteous. The price was acceptable being they squeezed me in with barley any notice, getting me on the road to my destination. I can’t thank Jim and company enough. God bless your business. Dave

reviews.author: Debra Long
reviews.text: Had engine replaced and new tires and alignment. Fast, friendly and reliable. Also had vehicle towed several times. They did a great job and delivered my vehicle safely.

reviews.author: Rachel Baxter
reviews.text: James R. with Jim's Auto came out and plugged a tire for me through AAA in less than 30 minutes! He even put air in another tire he thought looked low for me, very professional and quick service. I'd highly recommend him to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Julie Cashmore
reviews.text: Very bad business. Brought my car in because it was not getting gas to the engine. They told me they could not even do a diagnostic because my battery was bad. Very long story short, I paid 455.00 for a battery. They said they had done a diagnostic and was good to go. Half way home car doing the same thing I brought it in and paid for. I Barley made it back to shop!!!!! Would not go past 45mph Beware

reviews.author: Laura Beyea
reviews.text: Brought my car in with AAA very late on a Friday afternoon but the people at Jim’s were able to get my car in and fixed very quickly. I appreciated the quick service and the fact they didn’t try to upsell me for any other unnecessary services. Would highly recommend this shop to anyone local or just passing through.

reviews.author: Stephanie Otey
reviews.text: Had to call roadside assistance for help with flat tire. App originally estimated a hour or more. Brian McCormick Jr was the driver to assist me, he showed up in 20 minutes and had my tire changed in less than 10 minutes. Thank you Brian for your speedy response and assistance! Great service would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Broome
reviews.text: Great place. Friendly staff. They are very understanding and they want to get you the help you are looking for. They are one of the few around that will get you the best quality work at a price you would love. They will even work with you in some cases. You can definitely tell this is a family business because as you walk through the doors they welcome you with open arms. Once you go to Jim’s auto you become part of Jim’s family. All they ask is tell your friends. Look forward to coming back and buying another car from here next week.

reviews.author: John way Griff
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service , front of the house is very polite and professional. will recommend this place to anyone as their continuous visits

reviews.author: Leslie Warlick
reviews.text: I just had an excellent experience with Roger of Jim's Auto! He came out as soon as my towing request was entered and treated my daughter and I with respect and friendliness. Thank you, Roger, your quick and caring service was a big help to us today!

reviews.author: Gregory Kazian
reviews.text: Got my truck stuck in some wet section of my daughters home. AAA directed me to Jim's Auto for a winch-out. Driver arrived within 45 minutes and was able to pull my truck back onto the road. Very professional and polite and took care with my truck. Hope I never have to use them again but they will be the first ones I call when I need help.

reviews.author: Elspeth Murday
reviews.text: Been coming here for over a decade. They never remember me but they still always go out of their way to explain my options and give me a fair deal that works with my budget. They charge for their mechanics' time, as they should, but don't seem to mark up parts if you check against online wholesalers. Receptionists always pick up promptly and are present, polite, and helpful. Their lot is always packed but when I'm having trouble, they always seem to make time for me. Easy to see why they've been in business so long. Really recommend.

reviews.author: Bucky Richey
reviews.text: Just had my truck towed by Jim's Auto driver Kevin. He is a super nice guy and after we talked I found out that he had towed my daughter's car. She had a great experience also.

reviews.author: chris luper
reviews.text: Wife slid into a ditch backing out of a drive . The truck was in a 4ft ditch at a Very steep angle on it side. These guys took extra time and made sure to do every thing they could to get the truck out safe and undamaged.. a fireman who stopped by said we were lucky to have called this company. That he had rarely seen tow truck crews this concerned about no damage to the vehicle, and at a really reasonable price. He was impressed and so were we.

reviews.author: Ashley Kennedy
reviews.text: Tim came and towed my car after a former tow driver had messed up towing my all wheel drive car. Jim’s Auto made it right and sent out Tim. Tim was professional, knowledgeable, and extremely nice. He explained what he was doing and why. Great guy and business!

reviews.author: Katy C
reviews.text: We used Jim's Auto for towing with AAA at least 5 times. Every driver we had was friendly and helpful and I especially appreciated that each one acted professionally and made me feel safe. I would not hesitate to recommend their towing services.

reviews.author: Laura Cagle
reviews.text: Jim told me to bring my car today after work, so I did. Now that I’m here, there’s no open lifts. They don’t offer rentals either. Update: My car was supposed to be ready today and it’s not. Go figure.

reviews.author: mary ricker
reviews.text: It’s hard out here for a lady to trust car repair shops, but not at Jim’s!! Some of the best, most knowledgeable, and most honest guys in the business. Thank you, Jim and crew for instilling a sense of trust and honesty in every interaction!

reviews.author: Amanda Jo Venenga
reviews.text: Amazing tow service to having amazing people work on my car. Got it back to me with great speed to considering they had to file everything through insurance. Very satisfied with the work they did on my car. My one and only complaint was that they dumped everything from the console in the floor of my car when they had to replace the gear shift... but didnt bother picking it up or vacuuming out the cigarette butts they dumped out of the ash tray. (I'm not a smoker but my husband is) . . . Other than that I was very pleased with everything done. Very nice people.

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience, came in expecting a thousand dollar repair and left only paying $400. Tyler did great work, very nice front office staff.

reviews.author: Natalie Courvell
reviews.text: My car broke down on the interstate and it only took 20 minutes for the tow-truck driver to find me. Took super good care of me and my car, was very friendly and professional, and even went above and beyond. Jay earned his angel wings! Great service guys! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Mark Fields
reviews.text: Jim's auto did an incredible job replacing my starter in my 2004 Honda Pilot recently. My wife and I had just started our Easter vacation weekend when we stopped at the SC welcome center and my car wouldn't start. I called AAA and they sent out someone from Jim's Auto and he tested the battery but it was fine so he expected it was the starter. He called his shop and they sent out a wrecker to take us to Jim's Auto to check it out. The people there were very professional and caring and knew we were on vacation and stopped everything they were working on to replace our starter. They had us back on the road in 2hrs and for a very reasonable price. We consider ourselves very luck we broke down where we did and that Jim's Auto took care of us.

reviews.author: alvin hong
reviews.text: jim's auto helped me out of a bind in fair play, sc. cannot thank the staff enough for taking such good care of my truck. so glad to be on the road again.

reviews.author: Jason Beasley
reviews.text: I have known Jim for many years. He is always crazy busy and can be insulting especially if he knows you well, but I wouldn’t bring any of my vehicles or my family’s vehicles to anyone else. His people and him do the best work for the best price, and if something goes wrong they will fix it. Very happy with Jim’s Auto.

reviews.author: Ben Reppucci
reviews.text: I brought my truck here because my air conditioning was not working. I researched the issue and told them it was the compressor. They told me it would take 2 days and $300 and they could get started on Tuesday if I could drop my truck off in the morning, which I did. Wednesday afternoon I finally get a call and they tell me that my compressor is bad and it will be $555 and they can have it done on Friday. Reluctantly, I said ok. Friday at 4:45 I hadn't heard anything so I called and they told me it would be Monday before they were done. (Very inconvenient not to have a vehicle for the weekend.) Finally Monday I went to pick it up and they told me it would be $682. I told them that they had told me it would be $555, so she offered to take a half hour of labor off. I said that wasn't good enough, so she took an hour off and charged me $572. They did fix my A/C, but I noticed the next day that my trailer hitch was missing, and they had cracked my dash panel, which now makes a vibrating noise when driving. Overall it was a disappointing experience, but they did replace my A/C compressor which fixed my problem. So they get 2 stars.

reviews.author: Patrick Belk
reviews.text: I drive a 1995 Mazda Miata. I have had this car towed all over the country many times with AAA. A kid with Jim's Towing refused to tow me because of "modifications". The car was towed the night before by Fricks with zero issues. If you do not have a brand new vehicle with OEM parts do NOT call Jim's towing as they are liable to give you a hard time and refuse a tow!

reviews.author: Critty Cothran
reviews.text: Had truck problems, called AAA and was very lucky to get the tow driver I got. Jose was extremely helpful and went the extra mile and then some to make a bad situation not so bad. Very kind and helpful not enough stars for him

reviews.author: Richard Nicholls
reviews.text: From the tow to the repair, first class service. They replaced my alternator, in a car (MBZ) that most mechanics won’t even open the hood! Very happy with repair & cost.

reviews.author: constance mawyer
reviews.text: The entire experience was easy with the staff. Tow drivers were courteous and professional. Came to pick cat up quick. Fixed the problem at a reasonable price. I'll use them every time

reviews.author: Deanna Pollard
reviews.text: I've had a few tow truck drivers from Jim's Auto come out and help me as a AAA customer. This evening, Jose came out and helped me determine that what I thought was a required tow to a dealership was actually just a battery that bit the dust. I couldn't have been more thankful for someone coming out at 9 at night and still being so polite.

reviews.author: Ginnessa McGee
reviews.text: Got charged $112 for a "fuse" cause they were too lazy to hook up a computer to see what was wrong with my car. Not happy with this place. Side note the problem with my car was an inverter water pump was going bad. They couldn't even bother to find out what the codes meant to save me time & money. Not very honest people. Not sure how they got so many great reviews unless they faked them.

reviews.author: Common Sense
reviews.text: Jeff at Jim's Auto helped me get on the road quickly after a timing belt and water pump issue. I am, perhaps, considered a traveling sales person and a AAA member. The tow driver advised I needed a good mechanic and referred me to Jim's. Of course, I did not want to be shut down long for business reasons. I am realistic, however, and understand delays.Got me out ahead of schedule! Thanks!

reviews.author: Colton Moritz
reviews.text: James really helped me out with a battery problem today. Genuinely happy to help. Easy process. Quality service.

reviews.author: danny arrant
reviews.text: Honest and easy to do business with.not many people do business with a handshake. Jim and his mother are good people who can be trusted and will help you through the insurance process. Even took care of my rental truck.

reviews.author: Nik Feick
reviews.text: Terrible mechanic. Charged a ton and didn’t even end up finding the issue with my car. Bad customer service as well. Listen to the bad reviews and don’t bring your vehicle here

reviews.author: Aya Jenè
reviews.text: We popped a tired on the way from Atl to Dc and had to get towed by Jim’s super friendly people and got us back on the road in 2 hours ! Definitely recommend

reviews.author: Scott Stevenson
reviews.text: Was quoted a price for parts and labor at $307. Arrived to get my vehicle and the bill was $570. Mechanic telling me that he quoted me the wrong part and the actual part needed cost much more. No call or permission to complete work with new inflated part price. Would have been much better if they give you the option of taking the vehicle somewhere else instead of getting robbed. Now I know where not to take my vehicles for repair.

reviews.author: Tammy Bonner
reviews.text: Wasn't very pleasant, it was a hot day had my mom with me. I was giving them the title to get my things out of truck. It was close to closing but it take them few because of a phone call. Anyways I told her after signing finally that I was going down to get my things and when I got everything and went to leave the gate was locked. It took about 30 minutes to get out. She did come let us out and was ot nice to see her. My mom needed air my air conditioner broke.

reviews.author: Khristy Marano
reviews.text: AAA sucks....BUT, David at Jim's Auto Rocks! AAA dispatched him to tow us but failed to tell him we had a trailer attached to our truck. Even though he wasn't equipped to tow us, he went above and beyond and made phone calls in an attempt to get us home. It's discouraging enough to be stuck in this situation, and with having called every tow company in the area and even had one that could but told us they didn't want to fool with it, but this guy came out, couldn't help, but went out of his way to find us help. Really restores faith in humanity. Thank you David! We appreciate you.

reviews.author: Diego Gac
reviews.text: Larry and her wife were amazingly helpful and super friendly. Dennis was also very helpful towing our car to the shop! I really wish everyone was as nice and helpful like them!

reviews.author: Daniel Whitehead
reviews.text: Took in my truck for no oil pressure. Said they put on a manual gauge and it worked so then took it off and put it back the way it was but told me three times the oil pump is working. Went to pick it up I had a ticking noice very noticeable that wasn’t there when I dropped it off. Got it home but on a manual gauge myself no pressure. Oil pump had gone out so honestly believe they don’t have a single mechanic at this establishment. Won’t be taking my vehicles here any more as for now I have to rebuild a motor

reviews.author: April Bishop
reviews.text: Tyler was very professional and fast and funny while installing my battery. I will recommend Jim’s auto to anyone. And also AAA ROADSIDE SERVICES TO ANYONE AND ASK FOR TYLER. He was very cute

reviews.author: Beth Tilton
reviews.text: I had an emergency with a Tahoe on Tuesday afternoon. To make things worse I was loaded down with a trailer carrying 80 bales of hay. They looked at the vehicle, quoted it and had me on the road the next day. I really can't say enough about their customer service and efficiency. Thank you to everyone there. -Beth

reviews.author: Julie Sassen
reviews.text: Jay was amazing! We were stranded on a back road with a flat tire. He arrived within 30 mins! COVID19 made getting us anywhere difficult. Jay went above and beyond to get us back home to Asheville. Many thanks for rescuing us.!

reviews.author: David Hammond
reviews.text: Great garage reasonable prices and honest above all others... I'll tell you the same again every time i go to Jim's Auto they are polite & years everybody like family... Jim isn't Mr Nice Guy but he's a mechanic/business owner but he's a kind hearted guy if you get to know him...i haven't had much conversation with him but his actions speak louder than words..

reviews.author: Meghan Morin
reviews.text: Great shop very friendly guy fixed both cv joints/axles on my Honda Accord in one day on 24 hours notice! Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Carter
reviews.text: God, this place a LIFE SAVER !!!!! I had my car break down and called AAA where they towed me to Jim's, I am soo impressed with how helpful they are, from the towing to their place of business!!! Couldn't ask for better service HANDS DOWN !!!

reviews.author: Carol Adams
reviews.text: I was towing a boat and lost a wheel, Jim's Auto showed up in 30 minutes with a rollback and took great care with boat and trailer. These guys are the best. I recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Troy Ward
reviews.text: I had my car towed to this place. My car quit cranking. They don't have a real mechanic I don't recon. Because a few days later they towed my car back with a 200 dollar bill on what they had not done. Go to a place with a real mechanic that went to school. They are worth there money. Jim's auto is no good.

reviews.author: Rudolph Carroll (Indigo-WyndWalker)
reviews.text: This is the last towing company in Oconee County to call on if you are involved in a accident. Especially if it's around the Christmas holidays. My wife was on Hwy.188 Dec.24 after leaving work from Beyond the Bull. We were having heavy rain and storms that night. She topped a hill coming to the first bridge back toward Seneca. The S.C.H.P. Trooper asked did she have a preference and she said no, so he called for next in rotation. It so happened to be Jims. My wife was told to call someone to pick her up. To be on the rotation list in S.C. you are as the towing company supposed to give a ride to a safe place considering the tow truck driver followed the folks who got out to pick her up that night for me, all the way to Blackjack Rd. Now we live immediately first drive on right. We had the money to pay for the tow right then. So imagine my surprise when the driver turned left up N. Blackjack instead of right. She was never asked what to do or if she had the money for the tow. So to be on the rotation list in this state you also have to make yourself available to the public 365 days a year... do you think they were no... we went and had witnesses on the 25th,26th,27th & the 28th finally caught someone there. I went into their office to ask how much the bill was... when the guy told me $546. & some change I almost went off. These people are not honest at all when I explained what had happened his only words to me was well we can work with you, yeah right... so Jim f#&$ off you piece of Sh!#

reviews.author: Amy Allen
reviews.text: I needed to have my car towed and James came and got it he was very pleasurable to talk to. Then Mr. JIM CALLED and talked to me about my car then I went and meet him face to face. I highly recommend Jims Auto

reviews.author: Jane Morrison
reviews.text: I was very happy with the work They did on my Chrysler Concorde. I would recommend them highly to anyone needing work done on their cars.

reviews.author: Ashley McDaniel
reviews.text: Liars and theifs! Had to go get my car after 5 weeks! Not only was it not fixed, but wires were cut and hanging and randomly twisted together! Nothing was put back together. Had to bring to dealership to get repaired.

reviews.author: Marizol Allen
reviews.text: Very nice and did a great job! They took care of immediately and fair! Hope no one ever gets stranded but if it's out of your control, Jim's Auto will take care of you.

reviews.author: Amanda Allen
reviews.text: This company came to the rescue when I locked my keys in my car. They are reliable and got the job done when another company was unsuccessful at unlocking my car. Thank you!! 5 stars!

reviews.author: Joan Spencer
reviews.text: Great service, had to have my battery replaced took less than 30minutes. I'm very pleased with the friendliness and quality of Jim's Auto.

reviews.author: Joan Sanford
reviews.text: They responded to a AAA roadside assistance call. It was a four hour wait to change a tire. Not their fault. They were just fine but that tells you that AAA has problems!!

reviews.author: Kendal Williams
reviews.text: I was pulled over in there parking lot on a moped my. moped was impounded so I owner requested they tow my moped they literally just had to push it threw the gate that's all and wanted 300 dollars to get it out 12 hours later I only. paid 300 for that moped so needless to say they got a moped for 1 minutes work. do anything they can to rip a man off .

reviews.author: Jen Latta
reviews.text: Great people and fantastic service! They got my husband back on the road the same day. Can't recommend them enough!!

reviews.author: off road Nation unlimited
reviews.text: I had a light service driver by the name of Jake come out there to change my tire at dollar general drive by me 3 times as I was standing there waiving him down then he pulled in and drove off and Jim’s wouldn’t answer the phone don’t go there horrible customer service horrible employees. Jim’s is a theif and is just out to get money don’t have your cars towed by this company horrible company

reviews.author: Timothy Moriarty
reviews.text: Jim's Auto handled my extensive accident damage (body and mechanical) perfectly. Great communication and timely repairs.

reviews.author: scott gough
reviews.text: The guys from Jim's came to Tim's Harley Davidson in Anderson sc to pick up my bike which had broken down on the way to north Carolina and delivered it to conyers Georgia the same day for it to be fixed. A big thank you guys.

reviews.author: Travis Williams
reviews.text: Good people known him and his family for around 20 years. Good people. Towing service helps and gets people where they need to go. Plus he works on any automobile.

reviews.author: Chase Jones
reviews.text: Do NOT buy parts from Ray. The axle I bought was supposed to have a limited slip in it and I paid more because of that. The axle did not have a limited slip, after calling Ray he revealed that he didn’t even know what a limited slip was. He would not give me back my money and stopped taking my calls all together.

reviews.author: Nathan Paul
reviews.text: Jim is looking out for the best option for your situation. He cares about his employees and wants to do fair business. talk to him, I'm sure something good will come of it.

reviews.author: Wb DD
reviews.text: Car can’t start so AAA towed it to here. They did not even take a look at it after 1 week. And cannot find the problem after another week. They did fix the car, which costs me $360 for a $60 sensor.

reviews.author: Cara Harrison
reviews.text: Brian McCormick is the best thank you for being so quick to help my sister. You are appreciated because we've had to wait hours for help..

reviews.author: Jacob Welborn
reviews.text: They are a bunch of crooks do not take your vehicle there or buy from them. Now I have pay almost 500 dollars to the DMV because they didn't do what I paid them to do

reviews.author: Sharon Roy
reviews.text: Just had to be towed by this company , operator James C. Cannot say enough wonderful things about him!!! Made a tough situation enjoyable!!! Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Kaileigh Byrne
reviews.text: We brought our car here for a fuel pump issues, and everyone we interacted with was fantastic. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: David Fields
reviews.text: Worst repair facility I've ever used. Repaired vehicle from accident incorrectly. Took back so they could make it right all they did was use my gas and did not do anything. Stay away from this place bad business.

reviews.author: Kevin McFarland
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful towing service. The driver was knowledgeable and friendly. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Ray Seward
reviews.text: They charge me 3 times the price that I could buy at O'Reilly. Labor should have been 3 hours but they charged me for 6 hours. I could have don't it myself for 66% of the cost but I had open heart surgery.

reviews.author: Robert Marlowe
reviews.text: This place is my go-to place for my family and me. They are very knowledgeable people, and they try to get your vehicle back to you as fast as possible!

reviews.author: Deborah Yastremski
reviews.text: Took my neighbor to pick up his car. He has an accident and they fixed all the damage,it looks good as new!!!

reviews.author: Justice League
reviews.text: Great service, prompt and courteous. A rare find these days. I'll be back for all my needed repairs! 5 star!!

reviews.author: Angel Fields
reviews.text: Worst repair experience ever. Had to take back because of poor workmanship. They still didn't repair it right and ran all my gas out. Stay away from this hack shop.

reviews.author: Mike Mayes
reviews.text: Awesome guy, good business man, knows his stuff. And always to good work since they been open for business.

reviews.author: Kathy Rice
reviews.text: This is the second time Jim's Auto has fixed one of my vehicles and did a jam up job. Thank you Jim!!

reviews.author: mike turner
reviews.text: I had a flat on my motorcycle on 8/10/2026 and Josh brought his flatbed and we got it loaded up and hauled right into my driveway at my garage. Great guy and excellent work. He was at my breakdown site in less than 10 minutes.

reviews.author: Ruthe B Brackett
reviews.text: Jim’s Auto has been servicing out vehicles for years. I trust Jim and his auto technicians completely.

reviews.author: Andrew Nelson
reviews.text: As someone who knows how important quality workmanship and honesty are in the automotive industry, I can confidently say Jim’s Auto stands out. They treat every customer like family, do quality work, and are upfront every step of the way. No gimmicks, no pressure, just honest people who genuinely care about getting you back on the road safely. In a world where it’s hard to know who to trust, Jim’s Auto has earned mine. If you need repairs or maintenance, save yourself the time and go here first. You won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Kevin H Roberts
reviews.text: I was surprised to find such a full-service, highly professional shop in such a rural area. They towed me in immediately, diagnosed the problem, repaired the vehicle and checked that it was fully road worthy before letting me have it. And they are really nice people to boot! Highly recommended!
